snippet.title: DEAD TAKE | OUT NOW | OFFICIAL LAUNCH TRAILER
snippet.description:
Dead Take is OUT NOW on Steam and the Epic Games Store! 

🏰 Set in a beautiful but eerie Hollywood mansion
🔎 Play as an actor (Neil Newbon) searching for his missing friend (Ben Starr)
🧩 Solve puzzles in the abandoned mansion
✂️ Splice together live action videos
🎥 Discover cameos from an all-star cast

Also starring:
Jane Perry
Alanah Pearce

With cameos from:
Connor CDawgVA Colquhoun
Laura Bailey
Sam Lake
Matthew Mercer
Sam Willingham

🎞️ Dead Take on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3352690/Dead_Take/

🎞️ Dead Take on Epic Games Store: https://store.epicgames.com/p/dead-take-532460

A dark psychological horror about two actors vying for the same role, made by the BAFTA-winning team behind Tales of Kenzera: ZAU.

Dead Take is a first person escape-room-style horror set in a luxurious and private Hollywood mansion belonging to a powerful film exec. 

As Chase (Newbon), enter the mansion and solve puzzles as you explore in search of your friend, fellow actor Vinny (Starr). 

Are you ready to take your shot?

About Surgent Studios:
Surgent Studios creates games about the things that make us human. The BAFTA-winning studio behind Tales of Kenzera: ZAU is currently working on a number of projects including Project Uso, an Afro-gothic action-horror RPG set in the Tales of Kenzera universe, which the studio revealed in 2024. For more information, visit https://www.surgentstudios.com/. 

About Pocketpair Publishing:
Pocketpair is a Japanese video game developer best known for their hit game Palworld, as well as their other popular titles Craftopia and Overdungeon. Founded in April 2015, the company has gained international recognition for developing innovative games that blend various genres and gameplay mechanics. For more information, visit https://www.pocketpair.jp/publishing
